  "summary": "Sets the QT_ASSUME_STDERR_HAS_CONSOLE=1 environment variable when running Windows unit tests in CI. This overrides Qt's console detection to ensure test reports from test_bitcoin-qt.exe are printed to stderr.",
  "problem": "In GitHub Actions environments on Windows, test processes run without an attached console. Qt's internal stderrHasConsoleAttached() check returns false, suppressing all output from test_bitcoin-qt.exe and preventing developers from seeing test failures or diagnostics in CI logs.",
  "evidence": [
    "\"When run in the GHA environment, there is no console attached, so Qt's stderrHasConsoleAttached() returns false and the entire test report is lost.\" (description)"

result.summary: Sets the QT_ASSUME_STDERR_HAS_CONSOLE=1 environment variable when running Windows unit tests in CI. This overrides Qt's console detection to ensure test reports from test_bitcoin-qt.exe are printed to stderr.
result.problem: In GitHub Actions environments on Windows, test processes run without an attached console. Qt's internal stderrHasConsoleAttached() check returns false, suppressing all output from test_bitcoin-qt.exe and preventing developers from seeing test failures or diagnostics in CI logs.
evidence: "When run in the GHA environment, there is no console attached, so Qt's stderrHasConsoleAttached() returns false and the entire test report is lost." (description)
result.card: Sets QT_ASSUME_STDERR_HAS_CONSOLE=1 during Windows unit test runs in GitHub Actions. In Windows CI runners, absence of an attached console causes Qt to suppress all test output from test_bitcoin-qt.exe, hiding test results and failures. Forcing console output restores visibility into Qt test runs in CI logs.
